debug_log_message: debug a message to the console when the logging level is set to DEBUG or lower
info_log_message: info a message to the console when the logging level is set to INFO or lower
error_log_message: error a message to the console and trigger an assertion failure to halt execution
configure_logging_level: configure the global logging level using basicConfig to control which messages are printed
get_logger_instance: get a logger instance by calling getLogger with a name string to retrieve the rlstructures logging module
